GlobalSettings.Privacy.Message.Current:
Last updated: June 5, 2026

Overview
Noctra is a media player and playlist organizer. It does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include media content or IPTV subscriptions.

Information You Provide
The app may store profile details, protected PIN data, provider and source credentials, preferences, favorites, hidden categories, history, progress, downloads, EPG settings, Premium entitlement, and promotion-code state.

Local Storage
Settings, databases, logs, temporary data, and downloads are stored on your device, primarily under Documents\Noctra and selected download folders. Sensitive values use Windows protection where supported. Noctra does not sell personal information or build advertising profiles from viewing activity.

Network Connections and Third-Party Services
The app connects to providers, playlists, streams, EPG, metadata, update, and Microsoft Store services only to perform requested actions. Those services may receive IP addresses, headers, credentials, and requested resources and apply their own policies.

Diagnostics, Bug Reports, and Crash Reports
Noctra does not silently send reports. A report opens an editable email draft that may include app and system details, error information, stack traces, and a device-specific diagnostic identifier. Nothing is sent until you send it.

Microsoft Store Purchases and Reviews
Microsoft handles purchases, payments, taxes, refunds, reviews, and entitlements. Noctra does not directly process payment-card data.

Children and Profiles
Profiles, PINs, and filters do not replace parental supervision or guarantee third-party source suitability.

Data Retention and Deletion
Local data remains until removed. You may clear app data or delete Documents\Noctra and custom download folders. Uninstalling may not remove those files. Support emails may be retained for support, security, abuse prevention, and legal obligations.

Data Sharing
Kynora Studio does not sell or rent personal information. Data is shared only at your direction, through voluntary support reports, when legally required, or to protect users, rights, and security.

Security
Reasonable local safeguards are used, but no storage or transmission is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your account, device, credentials, playlists, and sources.

Changes
This policy may change with application behavior, Store requirements, or legal obligations.

Contact
Privacy, deletion, or support questions: kynora.studio@gmail.com
GlobalSettings.Terms.Message.Current:
Last updated: June 5, 2026

Acceptance
Downloading, installing, or using Noctra means you accept these Terms.

No Content or Subscription Is Provided
Noctra does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include media content, playlists, links, or IPTV subscriptions and grants no access to paid or protected content.

Your Content Sources and Responsibilities
Use only sources you own, control, or may legally access. Follow copyright, licenses, provider terms, and applicable law. Do not access unauthorized content or bypass payments, access controls, DRM, or regional restrictions.

Third-Party Services
Third-party providers and sources are controlled by their owners. Noctra is not responsible for availability, legality, accuracy, quality, security, pricing, outages, changes, or content.

Downloads and Offline Use
Use downloads only when legally and contractually authorized, and delete them when access rights end.

Free and Premium Features
Features and limits may differ and change. Promotion codes may be temporary, limited, expire, become inactive, allow one use per device, or be withdrawn.

Microsoft Store Purchases
Microsoft handles purchases, payments, taxes, refunds, reviews, and entitlements under its policies. Noctra does not process card data directly.

Profiles, PINs, and Child Features
These organizational tools do not replace supervision, guarantee source safety, or block every inappropriate item.

Support and Enforcement
Support or developer-operated features may be restricted for infringement, abuse, fraud, attacks, or illegal activity.

Disclaimer
Noctra is provided "as is" and "as available." Playback, metadata, EPG, access, availability, and compatibility vary without guarantees of uninterrupted or error-free operation.

Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Kynora Studio is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, data loss, unavailable third-party content, provider outages, or claims arising from user-added sources. Non-excludable liability remains unaffected.

Changes
Terms may change with functionality, Store requirements, or legal obligations. Continued use constitutes acceptance where permitted.

Contact
Legal, privacy, or support questions: kynora.studio@gmail.com
